migration_flags.detail: margin, margin_percent, and purchase_price all carry precompute=True. Migration scripts must not bypass ORM create to avoid missing precompute triggers.

purchase_price has copy=False. When migrating historical SO lines, do NOT bulk-copy purchase_price from old DB; instead allow recomputation from current standard_price, or explicitly set the migrated value with a dedicated script step.
margin and purchase_price reference decimal precision record 'Product Price'. Confirm this precision record exists in target v19 database after migration.
sale.order.margin_percent uses aggregator='avg' (v17+ ORM attribute replacing group_operator). Confirm ORM version compatibility in target deployment.
sale.order.margin is fields.Monetary (not Float). If upgrading from a version where it was Float, the currency_id linkage must be correctly populated.

sale_purchase module does not write PO price back to sale.order.line.purchase_price. Any assumption that SO margin reflects actual PO cost is incorrect. AVCO/FIFO actual COGS may diverge from displayed margin.

purchase_price is a snapshot of standard_price at line creation time. For AVCO products, margin on historical orders does not reflect post-creation cost changes. This is by design but must be communicated to users.

key_findings.margin_percent_formula: line.margin_percent = line.margin / line.price_subtotal (0 if price_subtotal is 0)
key_findings.purchase_price_source: product.standard_price, UoM-converted then currency-converted to SO currency at order date_order
key_findings.purchase_price_editability: readonly=False allows manual override; copy=False triggers recompute from current product cost on SO copy
key_findings.order_margin_aggregation: sum of line margins (Python mapped or SQL _read_group depending on onchange vs batch path)
key_findings.order_margin_percent: order.margin / order.amount_untaxed (NOT average of line percentages)
key_findings.multi_currency: cost_currency_id = product company currency; converted to SO currency via res.currency._convert with date_order and round=False
key_findings.avco_fifo_behaviour: purchase_price is snapshot of standard_price; AVCO auto-updates standard_price but historical SO lines retain their snapshot; FIFO uses standard_price not actual COGS layers
key_findings.sale_purchase_interaction: no purchase_price writeback from PO to SO line
key_findings.thai_thb: no Thai-specific logic; THB handled by standard currency conversion mechanism
key_findings.delivery_line_branch: special branch for qty_delivered>0 and product_uom_qty==0 uses price_unit*qty_delivered as revenue base
key_findings.report_margin: sale.report adds margin field normalised to reporting currency via currency_rate division and account_currency_table multiplication
